import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Display the first few rows of each dataset to understand their structure
pollen_df.head(), time_series_df.head(), capital_df.head()

# Check the columns related to daggers in the time_series_df and capital_df
time_series_df[['CE', 'Dagger', 'Dagger_inter']].head(), capital_df[['BCE', 'ZDolch']].head()

# Check the range of years in the datasets
time_series_df[['CE', 'calBP']].describe(), capital_df[['BCE']].describe()

# Analyze the dagger-related Z values over time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Plot the Dagger Z values from time_series_data.csv
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger'], label='Dagger Z values (time_series_data)')
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger_inter'], label='Interpolated Dagger Z values (time_series_data)')
plt.xlabel('CE (Common Era)')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.title('Dagger Z values over time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Plot the ZDolch Z values from capital.csv
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(capital_df['BCE'], capital_df['ZDolch'], label='ZDolch Z values (capital)')
plt.xlabel('BCE (Before Common Era)')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.title('ZDolch Z values over time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Perform a statistical analysis to determine if the increase in Z values for daggers is statistically significant
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Filter the data for the time period of interest (CE -1000 to -500)
time_period_start = -1000
time_period_end = -500
filtered_data = time_series_df[(time_series_df['CE'] >= time_period_start) & (time_series_df['CE'] <= time_period_end)]

# Split the data into two groups: before and after the time period of interest
before_data = time_series_df[time_series_df['CE'] < time_period_start]
after_data = time_series_df[time_series_df['CE'] > time_period_end]

# Perform a t-test to compare the mean Z values before and after the time period of interest
t_statistic, p_value = ttest_ind(before_data['Dagger'], after_data['Dagger'])

t_statistic, p_value
